note: A sample of real customer messages the advisor answered in production, taken from the week before rel-0044 went out. Traffic does not arrive labelled: what a good reply to each of these has to carry is not in this file, it is in policy/index.json.

requests.message: Our nightly catalogue feed has been failing since Friday and the import log is full of rejected rows. Nothing about the file has changed on our side. What is going on?
We were charged twice for September. Same amount, same card, two minutes apart. Can you sort this out today please.
I got an email from what looks like your billing team asking me to confirm my card details on a page that is not your domain. I think it is phishing but I want you to tell me either way.
How many seats does the growth plan include, and if we upgrade halfway through the month do we pay the difference now or at the next invoice date?
Your dashboard was down for most of yesterday afternoon and our team could not work. Does that fall under the SLA and what happens now?
A contact has asked us to delete my data from your system, meaning theirs. What do we send you and how long does it take?
The validation step is rejecting about four hundred rows out of eleven thousand and the message just says invalid. Where do I see which rule each row broke?
We asked for a refund three weeks ago and nothing has arrived. The ticket says resolved. It is not resolved.
Can you confirm what your retention period is for uploaded files, and whether a data export includes the ones we have already archived?
Someone else logged in to our admin account at two in the morning from a country we do not operate in. We have changed the password. What else should we be doing?
Our csv upload worked last month and fails now with a column count error. The file is generated by the same script it always was.
If we downgrade back to the standard plan before the billing cycle ends, do the extra seats disappear straight away or at renewal?
There was a second incident this morning, shorter than yesterday's. Is this the same root cause and is anyone going to tell us before we find out ourselves?
Following up on the duplicate charge. Our finance team needs a credit note with a reference on it, not a promise in a chat window.
Is there a way to see who on our team changed a product price, and how far back that history goes?
Your help page mentions gdpr but not what you do when the request comes from someone who is not our customer. Which is it?
The import ran clean overnight and then failed again at six. Is something on your side rate limiting us?
We have had a report from a customer that one of our order pages has a vulnerability in the checkout form. I do not know if it is yours or ours.
What is your policy on a refund when the fault was ours but the charge was automatic? I would rather know than argue about it.
Where in the interface do I change the address that shows on the invoice? I cannot find it under company details.
Can you tell us whether the account was compromised before or after the password reset, because our insurer is asking for a timeline.
Our reporting page was down again at eleven and the status page said everything was fine. Which one should I believe?
The catalogue feed is fine but the images it references are not being picked up. Same feed, same paths as last week.
Our new finance lead wants to know what happens to the historic data if we ever leave. Not a threat, just planning.
